title: Hands-Up Halo
description: A screaming bright supersaw lead in the mid/high register, gated by a stepped tremolo rate and pumped by a square-wave LFO so it stabs like a euphoric hands-up hook. Over 32 cycles a square-pumped filter env opens and closes, the detune widens, and the room/delay tail blooms, then the whole arc resets.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<f4 f4 ab4 c5>*4").s("supersaw")
    .unison(7).detune(sine.slow(23).range(0.18,0.5))
    .tremolosync("<4 8 16 8>/8").tremolodepth(0.85)
    .gain(square.slow(2).range(0.5,1.05))
    .lpf(square.slow(7).range(900,5200))
    .lpenv(square.slow(16).range(2,7)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.12)
    .resonance(sine.slow(13).range(10,18)).ftype("ladder")
    .shape(saw.slow(29).range(0.2,0.55)).distort("<0.3 0.5>/8")
    .pan(square.slow(11).range(0.3,0.7))
    .room(sine.slow(32).range(0.25,0.6)).roomsize(4)
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.6").delayfb(0.55)
    .gain(0.9)
)
